hook: Invoicing with unlimited clients and users for $9.99 a month 🧾
summary: We compared 4 invoicing tools for freelancers. Billing Now is one flat plan, $9.99 a month or $99.90 a year, with unlimited clients and users and an AI assistant that drafts invoices. Zoho Invoice is free up to 500 invoices a year.
points: Billing Now: Stripe payment links, recurring invoices, estimates
Zoho Invoice: free, up to 500 invoices a year and 2 users
Invoice Ninja: free for 5 clients, Pro $14 a month
offer: The guide compares the yearly cost of all 4 tools.
caveat: Based on published pricing, not a hands-on test. Billing Now has a 3-day trial and no free plan.
